clue.text: VP insanely excited about a new state

taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Insanely' reads as an adverb modifying 'excited', but its letters are part of the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Pennsylvania is one of the fifty constituent states of the USA, an example of the category.

clue.text: Sound made by cow entering from Exeter, a very remote place it's unlikely to jump over

definitions.text: a very remote place it's unlikely to jump over

indicators.note: one thing entering another goes inside it, so the cow's noise sits within the Exeter piece

the noise a cow makes

explanation.surface: A lowing beast comes in from the Devon city of Exeter.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the nursery rhyme in which the cow jumped over the moon; a cow is unlikely to jump over a far more distant one.
explanation.definitionFit: An exomoon is a natural satellite orbiting a planet beyond our solar system, astronomically distant, and no nursery-rhyme cow could leap it.

clue.text: Nothing wrong in Head being inquisitive

the letter shaped like a zero

clue.text: Goat with anatomically incorrect horns? Some royal emblem!

explanation.walkthrough: The yale is one of the Queen's Beasts, so the hidden answer genuinely is part of royal emblems.
explanation.definitionFit: The yale is a mythical heraldic beast resembling a goat or antelope whose horns can swivel independently, unlike any real animal.

taken as written

clue.text: Cutting from azalea can't have a thorn, for example
